description_short: The Max Planck School of Biomedical Artificial Intelligence offers 25 PhD positions in a structured three-year program across Germany, starting September 2027. Students are co-supervised by two fellows; applicants name up to three potential supervisors and submit a CV, motivation letter and transcripts.
